periods.test_rule: run once with a configuration hashed and committed before the run; no tuning on test

decision_time_utc: 12:00:00 on every NYSE session day (08:00 New York, the live am run time); all period days are EDT

information_snapshot.rule: every item carries available_at <= T and is rejected otherwise; the snapshot is canonical-hashed and the hash is stored with the decision
information_snapshot.news: Alpaca /v1beta1/news, created_at < T AND updated_at < T (revised items are excluded, never shown in their later form)
information_snapshot.daily_bars: Alpaca /v2/stocks/bars 1Day raw, sessions whose close <= T only; crypto /v1beta3/crypto/us/bars 1Day bars whose day ended <= T
information_snapshot.sec: data.sec.gov submissions, 8-K filings with acceptanceDateTime < T only; CIK map is today's company_tickers.json (limitation)
information_snapshot.vintage: Historical archive retrieval does not prove original vintage. Private frozen input manifest must attest unrevised prices and point-in-time universe/identity evidence; absent proof blocks model decisions. Prediction reads are offline and every cache object is bound by digest in the proof manifest.

a_v1_as_live.prompt: Pinned model-neutral duel analyst/reviewer prompts, with identical stage schemas for both models
a_v1_as_live.universe: live grant universe: 25 stocks + XLK XLF XLE XLI XLV + SOL AVAX LINK DOGE LTC (BTC/ETH not in the live universe and protected 2026-09-01..2026-11-30); SPY and QQQ as unpredicted benchmarks
a_v1_as_live.context: per asset: 21 completed daily closes, 1/5/20 returns, vol_20d (trader_agent.data.price_summary); per asset up to 8 Alpaca headlines from the last 72 h; macro headlines tagged SPY/QQQ up to 15

b_v1_no_reviewer.analyst: shared raw analyst of a within each family

c_news_small_mid.candidates: symbols of Alpaca news created in [previous session close, T), items naming at most 2 symbols; US equities with price >= 5 USD and 20-session median dollar volume in (10M, 1B] USD (small/mid proxy: no market-cap source in scope); live-universe names, ETFs and benchmarks excluded; at most 40 candidates ranked by negative-keyword score then recency; at most 3 headlines each
c_news_small_mid.entry: open of the decision session (next open after T)

d_news_primary_only.from: c trades with primary-source filter; retain all c probabilities
d_news_primary_only.filter: c views only when a cited news item links the exact accession of an 8-K accepted in [T-72h,T); unrelated filings never qualify; missing evidence means abstention

costs.applied_to: the traded asset leg; the SPY-relative return measures the view, the hedge leg is not charged (stated limitation)

fills.a_b_1d: equities: first SIP stock trade in [session open+30s, open+31s), exit first trade in [session close-5min, +1s); missing trade = unlabeled; SPY same
fills.a_b_5d: equities only: entry = session open (daily bar), exit = close of session 5; secondary
fills.crypto_1d: entry open of exact 13:31 UTC minute, exit open of exact same minute 24h later; missing minute = unlabeled; no stale fills
fills.c_d: entry = daily open of the decision session, exit = daily close of session h

purpose: Research-only paired offline replay; no orders, training, web or external tools.

operator_amendment.scope: GPT joins the research replay through the Codex ChatGPT subscription only. This does not authorize GPT in the live trader or change the HTTP grant.

models.gpt_identity_evidence: requested model is pinned; server identity is checked if emitted, never fabricated when absent
models.isolation: empty cwd, ignore user config/rules, no web, shell, code mode host, plugins, skills, memory or MCP; no API-key fallback
models.isolation_runtime_note: CLI flags are verified offline; no real transport smoke test is permitted until input proof and night gates pass.

probe.limitation: Operator attests clean sessions and pre-call hashing. Non-flagging is not proof of no latent memory.

forecast_panel.probabilities: numeric [0,1] required for every eligible instrument and horizon, including ABSTAIN; no imputation for invalid/missing outputs
forecast_panel.trade: UP requires p>0.5, DOWN p<0.5, ABSTAIN permits any p. Trade decision independent of forecast. Review rejects retain a probability constrained toward 0.5.
forecast_panel.news_trade: separate chosen holding_sessions 2..10 and probability; fixed 2d/10d forecasts allow exact paired comparison regardless of chosen trades
forecast_panel.primary_only: same forecasts as c on ALL candidates; missing exact primary-source evidence causes trade abstention only
forecast_panel.target: gross asset return > gross SPY return over the identical interval; ties count 0
forecast_panel.crypto_spy: crypto 1d exact 13:31 UTC to +24h and midnight mark; SPY exact stock trade in [anchor,anchor+1s) during its session, last actual raw session close while closed. Crypto 5d is forecast but not scored (parent exclusion). No BTC/ETH protected data.

statistics.base_rate: Laplace (wins+1)/(n+2) per variant/fixed horizon. Dev uses only labels whose exit is strictly before that decision. Test uses a rate fixed from censored Jul-Aug dev labels before any test call; no test fitting.
statistics.paired_test: Exact two-sided block sign-flip on daily mean Opus-minus-GPT Brier and log loss, all same instruments/days/horizons paired, nonoverlapping blocks of 10 NYSE sessions anchored at period start; Holm correction over all named panel/loss comparisons. No trade-conditioned probability selection.
statistics.pnl: fixed initial equity; equal weights within actual entry cohorts; max horizon capital divisor 1/5/10; mark daily, costs charged on entry/exit; calendar days including zeros, Sharpe annualization sqrt(365)
statistics.ess: cluster/day Kish and day ICC design effect for forecast loss and trade returns; paired independent-block count also reported
limitations: Only 28 test sessions; up to three 10-session blocks, coarse paired p-values. No general superiority claim from an underpowered replay.
Latent model memory cannot be ruled out by non-flagging probes.
Universe/identity and original data vintage require genuine sealed evidence before any decision.
Crypto 5d and boundary-crossing outcomes excluded with counts; missing eligible fills/marks block scoring.
SPY-relative P&L charges asset-leg costs only; zero-cost SPY hedge is a stated limitation.
Wilson intervals are descriptive and ignore clustering; ESS is diagnostic, not a proof of independence.

input_proof.scoring_requires: outcome_cache sealed by file digests; every model reads identical offline cache; test needs committed input seal

robustness_anonymized.variant: b, both families, every fourth dev session; no extra test calls
robustness_anonymized.method: same parent stable per-day identity codes, headline masks and return-preserving price rescaling; same seed for both models
